serverInfo.description: Astro Agents — a research-grade, verifiable astronomical data and computation API for developers, researchers and astronomy, calendar, observation and data applications. From the NASA/JPL DE440 ephemeris: sunrise, sunset and twilight, altitude and azimuth, observation windows, the Moon's phase and distance, the day's sky for a place, planetary positions (geocentric & heliocentric, ecliptic & equatorial), angular separations, longitude time series, eclipses with local circumstances, planetary phenomena, seasons, time scales and coordinate conversion, and a to-the-minute celestial event calendar (solar and lunar eclipses, stations, lunations), 1800-2200. Any date — past, present or future — reproducible: no LLM, historical time zones resolved for you, every result SHA-256 hashed and checkable, accuracy benchmarked against NASA/JPL Horizons. A free key with an email, plans by card, or, for software agents, prepaid credits or pay per call in USDC (x402, MPP). Data only — no predictions, never a signal or forecast.
